links.outcome: Proportion of AI-generated visit summaries meeting sixth- and eighth-grade readability benchmarks
links.effect: Mean FKGL 9.3; only 0.4% (4/982) met sixth-grade and 14.2% (139/982) met eighth-grade threshold.
links.quote: Only 0.4% (4/982) of PVS met the sixth-grade benchmark and 14.2% (139/982) met the eighth-grade threshold.

links.outcome: Reading grade level of AI-generated patient-facing summaries relative to recommended sixth-grade level
links.effect: Mean FKGL 9.3 (SD 1.2), FRES 57.6 (fairly difficult); GFI 12.4, CLI 11.0, SMOG 12.4.
links.quote: Among 982 analyzed PVS, the mean FKGL was 9.3 (SD 1.2, 95% CI 9.2-9.4) and the mean FRES was 57.6 (SD 7.9, 95% CI 57.1-58.1), corresponding to "fairly difficult."

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of readability of AI-generated patient visit summaries from an ambient AI scribe deployed in an orthopedic clinic; evaluates readability performance against benchmarks without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
